summary: {member} remembers who did engineering on an earlier asphalt job and the manager checks which company employed that person.
realLife: In Sulphur, a council member recalled that the earlier paving contractor had an engineer who designed its road work; the manager asked about the contractor’s role.
gates: A participant’s recollection of engineering responsibility on an earlier contract.
inGame: needs: a participant’s recollection of engineering responsibility on an earlier contract.

turns.pulledBy: The old contract bears out the recollection.

turns.what: Ask staff to retrieve the project file.
turns.writesBack: Keep the recollection attributed to its speaker..
